title.zh: 有界各向异性试探参数优化

summary: Perform a local fit within finite valid bounds and a total scientific-call budget, never allowing a failed trial to become the best, and return the revalidated state at the actual terminal point.

capability: Local bounded fit within a fixed scientific-call budget, returning the revalidated state at the actual terminal point.
operation: initial_params, bounds, method, trial_evaluator and budget -> parameters, residuals, forward/optimization state and log
discovery.model: Bounded local numerical optimization; no equilibrium equation, global search or statistical identifiability proof.
discovery.geometry: Defined by the trial evaluator; no fixed spatial grid is assumed.
discovery.boundary: All bounds finite and strictly increasing with initial values inside them; a wrong method, wrong left-hand side or invalid control is rejected directly with no out-of-bounds fallback.

identity.relation: bounded parameters and a fixed-size trial to a local fit record validated by a fresh call
identity.direction: initial_params, bounds, method, trial_evaluator and budget -> parameters, residuals, forward/optimization state and log
identity.definition: Validate every static control first. For optional LHS, check the complete design against the bounds and count, then evaluate it in order and use only valid samples as starting points. least_squares uses residuals; minimize uses L-BFGS-B with the squared sum. An invalid trial supplies an N-vector penalty to the optimizer but never participates in best_valid_trial. The budget counts LHS, numerical differences and terminal calls, reserving two slots for terminal/valid-fallback validation. A normally returned optimizer x must be revalidated with a fresh forward call; if the terminal point is invalid, only a revalidated historical valid candidate may be returned, with converged=False.
identity.model: bounded local numerical optimization, with no equilibrium equation, global search or statistical identifiability proof
identity.coordinates: fit_keys order or bounds insertion order forms the optimization vector; non-fitted parameters are retained
identity.boundary: All bounds must be finite and strictly increasing, and initial values must lie inside them. A wrong method, wrong LHS or invalid control is rejected directly, with no out-of-bounds fallback.
assumptions: The trial returns a fixed N-vector of finite residuals, a matching chi2, a forward state and a failure reason.
A valid trial must have a real converged=True forward state, no failure_reason, and valid not set to False.
The penalty is only for numerical control and cannot serve as a physical solution or identifiability information.

inputs.name: initial_params
inputs.description: Complete initial values; non-fitted parameters are deep-copied unchanged.
inputs.constraints: All fitted values are finite and lie inside their corresponding bounds.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.description: Parameter lower and upper bounds and their default order.
inputs.constraints: Every supplied interval is finite with low<high.

inputs.name: method
inputs.constraints: Only least_squares or minimize; the latter explicitly uses L-BFGS-B.

inputs.name: trial_evaluator
inputs.units: residuals are dimensionless; state follows the scientific contract
inputs.constraints: Must supply residuals, chi2, equilibrium and failure_reason; valid, if present, must be boolean.

inputs.name: fit_keys
inputs.constraints: Nonempty and duplicate-free, and present in both initial_params and bounds; defaults to the bounds keys.

inputs.name: lhs_sampler
inputs.constraints: Must be callable when n_initial_samples is enabled; every sample must contain exactly the fitted keys, be finite and lie inside the bounds.

inputs.name: n_initial_samples
inputs.description: Number of LHS samples before optimization.
inputs.constraints: From 1 to max_evaluations-3; booleans and non-integers are rejected; None does not call LHS.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.dtype: seed accepted by the sampler, or None
inputs.constraints: Ignored when LHS is disabled; the same validated sampler and seed produce the same design.

inputs.name: residual_size
inputs.constraints: When omitted, it is taken from the first trial's nonempty one-dimensional vector and then held fixed; the graph entry point always derives it from observations first.

inputs.name: failure_penalty
inputs.description: Per-component penalty supplied to the optimizer for an invalid trial.
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive, with N*penalty^2 finite; default 1e12.

inputs.name: max_evaluations
inputs.description: Common upper bound on all actual scientific trial calls.
inputs.constraints: At least 3; includes LHS, differences and fresh terminal validation; it must not be confused with SciPy nfev.

outputs.name: best_parameters
outputs.description: The actual revalidated optimizer terminal point; on failure it may be a revalidated historical valid candidate.
outputs.constraints: None if there is no valid candidate. A normal terminal point agrees with optimizer_summary.parameters; no claim is made that it is always the minimum over the whole log.

outputs.name: chi2
outputs.description: Normalized squared sum of the returned state; N*penalty^2 when there is no valid solution.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; a failure penalty must be read together with the state.

outputs.name: residual_vector
outputs.description: Fixed-size residuals of the same trial that produced the returned state.
outputs.constraints: Parameters, state and residuals belong to the last validated trial; the penalty is returned when there is no valid solution.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: The optimizer succeeded and the latest forward evaluation at its actual terminal point is valid.
outputs.constraints: False on fallback, exhausted budget or an invalid terminal point; it does not mean small residuals, a global optimum or identifiability.

outputs.name: forward_converged
outputs.description: The currently returned state has actually passed forward and trial validation.
outputs.constraints: May be True while the optimizer has not converged, indicating a usable partial result.

outputs.name: optimizer_converged
outputs.description: Raw boolean projection of SciPy success.
outputs.constraints: A constant failure penalty can also stop the optimizer; it cannot be treated alone as physical success.

outputs.name: equilibrium
outputs.description: Forward state validated in the same call as best_parameters and residual_vector.
outputs.constraints: None when there is no valid returned candidate.

outputs.name: evaluation_log
outputs.description: Parameters, chi2, valid, failure_reason and source of every actual evaluation.
outputs.constraints: source is latin_hypercube, optimizer, terminal or best_valid_recheck.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.description: Reason for budget exhaustion, numerical failure, terminal failure or optimizer stop.
outputs.constraints: None only when both succeed; contract errors are raised.

outputs.name: optimizer_summary
outputs.description: Method, success, status, message, nfev and parameters from the actual result.x.
outputs.constraints: SciPy nfev is not the total number of scientific calls; it may be None when the budget is interrupted.

outputs.name: best_valid_trial
outputs.description: Complete record of the valid historical trial with the lowest chi2.
outputs.constraints: An observation record only; it is separate from the returned terminal point and must not be assigned another point's convergence state.

outputs.name: scientific_evaluations
outputs.description: Total number of actual trial calls.
outputs.constraints: Does not exceed max_evaluations; includes numerical differences and terminal validation.

outputs.name: max_evaluations
outputs.description: The validated upper bound on scientific calls for this run.

outputs.name: valid_trial_count
outputs.description: Number of valid trials in the evaluation log.

outputs.name: residual_size
outputs.description: Fixed residual size for this run.
outputs.constraints: All vectors have the same size.

outputs.name: identifiability
outputs.constraints: Fixed to not_established; a local stop is not an identifiability proof.

preconditions: The parameter domain, finite bounds, physical meaning of the trial and residual contract are explicit.
supported: Local least_squares/L-BFGS-B, optional deterministic LHS, failed-trial isolation, terminal binding and a finite budget.
excluded: Global optimality, confidence intervals, multimodal exploration or a general parameter-identifiability proof.
Packaging a failed zero residual or an old best state as convergence of the current optimizer.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError before any scientific call for an invalid method, bounds, initial values, keys, samples or budget; trial contract errors propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: A numerical exception in a custom trial with explicit residual_size is recorded as a fixed-size failure and consumes the actual call budget; when N has not been established, the exception propagates rather than inventing a dimension. Optimizer numerical exceptions and budget stops are reported separately; contract ValueError/TypeError/KeyError are not swallowed.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Optimizer stop and forward validity are returned separately; a fallback is never called converged.
failure_semantics.partial_results: best_valid_trial stores the historical valid minimum; best_parameters comes only from a fresh terminal or fallback validation; both are None when everything fails.

python.signature: optimize_anisotropic_parameters(*, initial_params, bounds, method, trial_evaluator, fit_keys=None, lhs_sampler=None, n_initial_samples=None, seed=None, residual_size=None, failure_penalty=1000000000000.0, max_evaluations=200)

example.description: A scalar example illustrating only the optimization control; see direct-anisotropic-inversion for the physical closed loop.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.inference import optimize_anisotropic_parameters
def trial(*, params):
    residuals = np.array([params['x'] - 3.0])
    return {'chi2': float(residuals @ residuals), 'residuals': residuals, 'equilibrium': {'converged': True}, 'failure_reason': None}
r = optimize_anisotropic_parameters(initial_params={'x': 0.0, 'fixed': 7.0}, bounds={'x': (-5.0, 5.0)}, fit_keys=['x'], method='least_squares', trial_evaluator=trial)
assert abs(r['best_parameters']['x'] - 3.0) < 1e-6
assert r['best_parameters']['fixed'] == 7.0 and r['converged']
assert r['chi2'] == min(e['chi2'] for e in r['evaluation_log'])
example.expected: Recovers x≈3, retains fixed=7 and the terminal point is actually forward-valid; an invalid method raises directly.

scope: Retains the original valid scalar recovery, LHS starting point and residual numerical assertions.
Invalid controls make zero scientific calls, a failed zero chi2 cannot become best, the dimension is fixed, and budget/terminal states are identical.
Two-parameter analytic recovery with real Picard and independent curved-field discrete-reference recovery.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to a bounded local anisotropic-parameter fit with a total scientific-call budget and a never-best failed trial rule. Evidence: `test_inference_physical_closure.py` contains 20 test functions, none of which references `optimize_anisotropic_parameters`, and is shared by 4 assets; `test_anisotropic_inference_independent.py` contains 1 test function, none of which references `optimize_anisotropic_parameters`, and is shared by 4 assets; only shared-file coverage is bound, so a pass is file-level rather than asset-isolated; the bounded example was executed by this audit. Oracle: independent analytic and discrete-reference comparisons in the bound inference files. It does not establish global optimality, confidence intervals/identifiability proofs, or packaging a failed/old state as optimizer convergence.
known_limitations: May stall near a constant penalty; finite LHS and local optimization do not guarantee finding a feasible point.
No automatic covariance, Fisher-rank or confidence-interval report is provided; additional scientific design is required.
The complete trial state is stored in best_valid_trial, and memory cost varies with the forward state.
